acceptance: Tests cover: regression over threshold exits 3; a slowdown under the threshold or under the minimum deltas exits 0; incomparable variants exit 4; incomparable timing modes exit 4 in both result-file mode and platform-run mode; a missing or corrupt result file exits 1; a usage error exits 2.
--allow-heterogeneous-comparison still bypasses the variant refusal, after which the normal codes apply.
compare --help and the user documentation list the codes, and the changelog.d fragment marks the change as breaking.
The perf step in .github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml still fails its job on a regression; the PR states how this was checked.
Smoke: run compare on real bundles for each of the four outcomes and show the exit status of each.
context:
Origin: adversarial review of an agent-facing strategy for BenchBox, 2026-11-12. Owner decisions quoted here were made on that date. Line numbers are hints; re-read the cited file before relying on them.

Evidence: the --fail-on-regression help text says 'Fail (exit 1)'; the two incomparable branches in the file-comparison path call sys.exit(1); the platform-run path raises ValueError wrapping IncomparableModesError.

Decision gate (before coding): search core workflows, the Makefile, scripts, tests and the benchbox-site docs for anything that matches compare's exit status exactly 1. List the consumers in the PR. If 3 or 4 already has a documented meaning anywhere in the CLI, stop and report; do not pick other numbers silently.

Verification rubric: pass only if each outcome has a test that would fail under the old single code, the four-outcome smoke is shown, and no other command's exit status changes.

Related, not duplicated: nightly-perf-gate-sensitivity-review-20261010 and perf-smoke-rebaseline-after-power-query-generation-20261103 own the nightly gate's thresholds and baseline.

Guardrails: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. One PR per item, squash-merged to develop (site work: one PR in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site). Add a changelog.d fragment for any user-facing change. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers) runs only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy (make comment-policy-check). Stop and report instead of widening scope; scope removed during review must be re-homed to a named item or dropped by the owner with a reason.
description:
Problem: benchbox compare exits 1 when a regression exceeds --fail-on-regression, when two results are not comparable (IncomparableVariantsError, IncomparableModesError), and on ordinary errors. A pipeline cannot tell 'slower' from 'cannot compare' from 'broken'.

Owner decision (2026-11-12): distinct codes now; the breaking change is accepted because the project is pre-1.0. Codes: 0 success, 1 error, 2 usage error (Click default, unchanged), 3 regression over threshold, 4 not comparable.

Non-goals: exit codes of run and every other command; thresholds, minimum-delta semantics and comparison maths; JSON output shape.
